name: 07030 · Hoboken, NJ
findings: ZIP 07030 (Hoboken) has 171 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 70 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07030 (Hoboken) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
